objective.text: Use previous keys for decryption during rotation while encrypting new values with the current key.

difficulty.rationale: Keep old protected values readable while moving new encryption to the new key.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: During a controlled key rotation, existing values use the old key and new writes must use the new key. Which configuration supports that transition?

options.text: Remove the old key immediately and expect the new key to decrypt all old values.
options.rationale: Ciphertexts protected by the old key do not become decryptable by an unrelated new key.
options.misconception: Ciphertexts protected by the old key do not become decryptable by an unrelated new key.

options.text: Alternate current keys on each request and keep no previous-key list.
options.rationale: That gives inconsistent read compatibility and no controlled transition boundary.
options.misconception: That gives inconsistent read compatibility and no controlled transition boundary.

options.text: Use the new key as current and retain the old key among previous decryption keys.
options.rationale: The current key encrypts new values; previous keys are tried when decrypting older protected values.

options.text: Use the old key as current and put the new key only among previous keys.
options.rationale: That keeps encrypting new values with the old key, contrary to the transition requirement.
options.misconception: That keeps encrypting new values with the old key, contrary to the transition requirement.
